description: This file defines the class 'soap_transport_http' which manages HTTP and HTTPS transport mechanisms for a SOAP client, including connection setup, request sending, response handling, authentication, and header management.

classes.name: soap_transport_http
classes.description: A class for sending and receiving SOAP messages over HTTP or HTTPS, supporting various authentication methods, proxy configuration, chunked transfer decoding, custom headers, and integration with cURL or socket-based transport.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the transport with a URL, optional cURL options, and whether to force cURL use.

methods.name: setCurlOption
methods.description: Sets a specific cURL option for the cURL handle.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Sets an HTTP header for the outgoing request.

methods.name: unsetHeader
methods.description: Removes a specified header from the outgoing headers.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Parses and sets the URL for the HTTP connection, including host, port, and path.

methods.name: io_method
methods.description: Determines whether to use socket or cURL based on configuration and URL scheme.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an HTTP or HTTPS connection using socket or cURL, configuring SSL, timeouts, proxy, and authentication as needed.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a SOAP message over HTTP/S, handling retries and connection setup.

methods.name: sendHTTPS
methods.description: Deprecated method, redirects to send(); intended for HTTPS-specific sending.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets authentication credentials and options for HTTP or SSL authentication.

methods.name: setSOAPAction
methods.description: Sets the SOAPAction header for the request.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Configures HTTP encoding (gzip, deflate) for the request.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Configures proxy settings for the request.

methods.name: isSkippableCurlHeader
methods.description: Checks if a curl header line should be skipped during response processing.

methods.name: decodeChunked
methods.description: Decodes a chunked transfer encoding stream into plain data.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs the raw HTTP request payload including headers and body.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends the prepared request payload over socket or cURL, manages headers and cookies.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Reads the server response, including headers and body, handling chunked encoding, redirects, authentication challenges, and decompressing content if needed.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the Content-Type header for the SOAP message.

methods.name: usePersistentConnection
methods.description: Requests the use of an HTTP keep-alive connection.

methods.name: parseCookie
methods.description: Parses a Set-Cookie header string into its components.

methods.name: getCookiesForRequest
methods.description: Generates the Cookie header string for including cookies in the request.
